asked.item: set up company name and address myself
email someone each month to get company details on invoices

verdict.reason: The help pages describe a self-service way to add company details to invoices through the billing portal, and state that future invoices will include the updated information.

steps.text: You can add the company details yourself: go to Settings > Billing and click "View Billing Portal".
In the billing information, update your company details, including your company name and address.
Future invoices will include your updated company information.
